description: Two players or two teams shown side by side, on the metrics that matter for their position by default — name metrics explicitly, or pass all:true, for the full set. Each side carries its source rank. States both figures and stops: it names no winner, no margin and no recommendation. `metrics` takes verified panel metric keys exactly as list_metrics returns them ("qb_anya.any_a"), or their plain-English names. A measure only run_stat_query computes, such as yards per attempt, is not a panel metric and is refused with the nearest ones.
name: compare_entities
title: Compare two players or teams
